fields.label: Has Employment Income
fields.question_text: Step 3 is about income. The form has three checkboxes: Employed, Self-Employed, and Not Employed. Which best describes your household? Say: Employed, Self-Employed, or Not Employed.

fields.label: Has Other Income (Section 4)
fields.question_text: Section 4 of the form covers other income types — things like Social Security, unemployment, pensions, investments, and more. This applies to everyone in the household regardless of employment status. Does anyone receive any of these other income types?

fields.label: SSDI Income
fields.question_text: Social Security Disability (SSDI): Does anyone receive this? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount — for example: Michael, $800. If no, say no.

fields.label: SSI Income
fields.question_text: Supplemental Security Income (SSI): Does anyone receive this? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Social Security Retirement Benefits
fields.question_text: Social Security Retirement: Does anyone receive this? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Social Security Survivors Benefits
fields.question_text: Social Security Survivors: Does anyone receive survivors benefits? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Unemployment Compensation
fields.question_text: Unemployment Compensation: Does anyone receive this? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Pension or Retirement Fund Income
fields.question_text: Pensions: Does anyone receive pension or retirement fund income? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Spousal Support / Alimony Received
fields.question_text: Spousal Support: Does anyone receive spousal support or alimony? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Railroad Retirement Benefits
fields.question_text: Railroad Retirement: Does anyone receive this? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Contributions from Others
fields.question_text: Contributions from Others: Does anyone receive regular cash from family or friends outside the household? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Investment or Dividend Income
fields.question_text: Investments: Does anyone have investment income such as dividends or interest? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Scholarships or Grants
fields.question_text: Scholarships or Grants: Does anyone receive this for living expenses? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Capital Gains
fields.question_text: Capital Gains: Does anyone have capital gains income from selling property or investments? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Farming or Fishing Income
fields.question_text: Gross Farming: Does anyone have farming or fishing income? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Rental Income
fields.question_text: Gross Rental: Does anyone have rental income? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Royalty Income
fields.question_text: Royalties: Does anyone receive royalty income? If yes, say the person's name and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Other Income Not Listed
fields.question_text: Other Income: Is there any other income not already covered — such as cash assistance or veterans benefits? If yes, describe the type, person, and monthly amount. If no, say no.

fields.label: Estimated Total Yearly Income This Year
fields.question_text: What is the estimated total household income for this calendar year?

fields.label: Estimated Total Yearly Income Next Year
fields.question_text: What is the estimated total household income expected next calendar year?

fields.label: Dependent Care Expenses
fields.question_text: Does anyone pay for dependent care (child care or adult day care) so they can work or go to school? If yes, how much per month?

fields.label: Spousal Support / Alimony Paid
fields.question_text: Does anyone pay spousal support or alimony? If yes, how much per month?

fields.label: Other Deductible Expenses
fields.question_text: Are there any other deductible expenses to report, such as student loan interest or educator expenses? If yes, describe and give the amount.

fields.question_text: Step 5 covers your family's current health coverage. Does anyone in the household have Medicaid? If yes, say their name(s). If no, say no.

fields.label: VA Coverage - Who Has It
fields.question_text: Does anyone have VA (Veterans Affairs) health coverage? If yes, say their name(s). If no, say no.

fields.label: Peace Corps Coverage - Who Has It

fields.label: Tricare Coverage - Who Has It

fields.question_text: Does Person 1 currently have health insurance through a job (their own or a family member's)?

fields.label: Person 1 Employer Insurance - Employer Name
fields.question_text: What is the name of the employer providing Person 1's health insurance?

fields.label: Anyone Offered Job-Based Coverage Not Enrolled

fields.label: Acknowledgement

fields.label: Signature Date
